summary: fix(shared): drop browser Sentry events from file:// pages
description:
Because:

* Browser Sentry received errors from locally saved FxA pages (file:// URLs).

This commit:

* Drops browser Sentry events whose page URL is not http or https, or cannot be parsed.
* Applies the check in sentry-utils beforeSendBrowser and in the older beforeSend.client.ts.
* Adds unit tests for kept, dropped and fallback URLs.

Closes FXA-15109
